candidates.requirement: The existing equality assertion must hold after a supported CBOR value is parsed, serialized, and parsed again.
candidates.target_route: Input bytes {0xf9, 0x7c, 0x01} decode as a half precision NaN. The changed float constructor stores NaN; to_cbor writes it as a double; the second from_cbor restores NaN; the entry compares the two JSON values.
candidates.failure_condition: JSON float equality uses ordinary floating point ==, so the two NaN values compare unequal and the existing assert(j1 == j2) fails.
candidates.alternative_paths: The entry has no guard or alternative comparison for NaN. Its exception handlers do not handle a failed assertion.
